scripts.text:
[Akagi]
Hmmm...
You must have come,
sensing that someone
is waiting for you here.
Tell me, do you seek
the path of patience?
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
嗯……
你一定是感应到
有人在这里等你，
所以才来的吧。
告诉我，你在寻求
忍耐之道吗？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Akagi]
I see.
To each his own,
I suppose. Take
care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
原来如此。
我想也是，人各有志。
请多保重。

scripts.text:
[Akagi]
Very well.
Then, let me
set you on that
path right away...
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
很好。
那么，我这就
为你指引那条
道路……

scripts.text:
[Akagi]
Hm? I cannot be
of any service to
you until you grow
a little stronger...
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
嗯？在你变得
更强一些之前，
我帮不上什么忙……

scripts.text:
[Akagi]
Hmm...
You and I...
We are fairly equal in
terms of combat ability.
Perhaps we can spar
together sometime.
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
嗯……
你我……
在战斗能力上
可谓旗鼓相当。
也许我们可以
找个时间切磋一下。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
I... I've never
seen a baby as
powerful as you!
G-get away, you
freak of nature!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
我……我从来没见过
像你这么强大的婴儿！
快滚开，你这个
自然界的怪胎！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Hm? Have you come to
learn how to be a Ninja?
You're not quite experienced
enough yet, so come back
after you're more familiar
with fighting monsters.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
嗯？你是来学习
如何成为忍者的吗？
你的经验还不太够，
等你对讨伐魔物
更熟悉之后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me.
H-hello?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下。
你、你好？

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
...............................
How did you do that?
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
……………………………
你是怎么做到的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do what? I didn't
do anything, I don't think...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
做什么？我觉得
我什么都没做啊……

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
H-How are you able to
see me? I'm supposed to
be invisible to the naked eye.
Ah, now I get it. Wildcat Joe
must have sent you to kill me! I won't fall for your tricks! Die!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
你、你怎么能看见我？
我明明应该对肉眼
隐形的才对。
啊，现在我明白了。
一定是野猫乔派你来杀我的！
我才不会上你的当！去死吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W-wait! I-I don't even
know who Wildcat Joe is!
Calm down, there's no
need to get violent!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等、等等！我甚至
都不知道野猫乔是谁！
冷静点，没必要
动粗！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
What...?
How did you dodge
all of my attacks?
You've got some talent,
I'll give you that.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
什么……？
你是怎么躲过
我所有攻击的？
不得不承认，
你确实有点天赋。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...............................
I came here hoping
to change my job
to a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
……………………………
我来这里是希望
转职成为忍者。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
...Oh. Is that all?
Hmm, you've got great
potential, but I can't help
you now. I've got too many
enemies, and I can't let my
guard down for even a second.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
……哦。就只是这样？
嗯，你很有潜力，
但我现在帮不了你。
我的敌人太多了，
哪怕一秒钟都不能放松警惕。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
That Wildcat Joe is
completely ruthless...!
He could strike at any time!
He'll do anything to achieve
victory over his enemies!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
那个野猫乔简直
冷酷无情……！
他随时都可能发动袭击！
为了战胜敌人，
他什么事都做得出来！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Wait, wait, I just
thought of something.
Maybe you can help me out.
Do what I ask, and I'll teach
you a few of my skills if you
really want to be a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
等等，等等，
我刚想到一件事。
也许你能帮我个忙。
如果你真的想成为忍者，
就照我说的做，
我会教你几招我的技能。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Hm? Well, alright.
Still, I don't see
why we can't help
each other in this
little predicament...
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
嗯？好吧。
不过，我不明白
为什么我们不能
在这个小困境中
互相帮忙……

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Great! Now, I wanted to
ask Wildcat Joe if he'd
agree to a temporary truce.
I'm aware that both of us
are out of weapons, so we
should get well equipped first.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
太好了！其实，
我想问问野猫乔
是否同意暂时休战。
我知道我们俩都没武器了，
所以我们应该先好好装备一下。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Please take this letter,
and deliver it to Wildcat
Joe in Einbroch. He's a master
of disguise, so keep a careful
eye out for him. Ah, and look
for him in a high place.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
请带上这封信，
把它交给在艾音布罗克的
野猫乔。他擅长伪装，
所以要仔细留意。
啊，还要去高处找他。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Yeah, Wildcat Joe
always did have a thing
for hiding in high places.
Anyway, after you give him
the letter, come back and
let me know his answer.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
是啊，野猫乔
一直喜欢躲在高处。
总之，你把信给他之后，
回来告诉我他的答复。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Even if this task
isn't that urgent,
please hurry over to
Einbroch and deliver
my letter to Wildcat Joe.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
虽然这个任务
没那么紧急，
但还是请尽快去
艾音布罗克，
把我的信交给野猫乔。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Did you deliver that
letter to Wildcat Joe?
I still need to know his
response to my proposal
for a truce. Anyway, see
if you can needle him for it.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
你把那封信
交给野猫乔了吗？
我还需要知道他对
我休战提议的回应。
总之，你去试探一下他。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Ah, you've returned.
So did Wildcat Joe send
you back here with his
response? Great, great,
please let me read it.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
啊，你回来了。
所以野猫乔让你
带着他的答复
回到这里了吗？
太好了，太好了，
请让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
What...?! How could he
reject my proposal for
a truce?! This can only
mean that he's made another
Kunai. Nuts! I have to catch
up to him, or I'm a goner!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
什么……？！
他怎么能拒绝
我的休战提议？！
这只能说明他又做了
一把苦无。可恶！
我必须赶上他，否则我就完了！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Listen, you've got to help
me out again! I need you to
gather some materials so that
I can craft my own Kunai to fight Wildcat Joe. Then, I'll go ahead
and change your job to a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
听着，你得再帮我一次！
我需要你收集一些材料，
好让我制作自己的苦无
来对抗野猫乔。
然后，我就帮你转职成忍者。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
All you need
to bring me is
^3355FF5 Cyfars^000000 and
^3355FF1 Phracon^000000.
Please get those
as quickly as you can!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
你只需要给我带来
^3355FF5个赛依伐^000000和
^3355FF1个强化武器金属-级数一^000000。
请尽快弄到这些！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? That's funny,
Wildcat Joe actually
asked me to gather
those same materials.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？真奇怪，
野猫乔也让我
收集同样的材料。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Curses! Then that means...
You actually helped Joe
in crafting his Kunai! No!
I should have thought about
that earlier! Well, it's too
late now. Just h-hurry it up!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
该死！那就意味着……
你竟然帮乔制作了苦无！
不！我应该早点想到的！
算了，现在说什么都晚了。
快、快点行动！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Hurry and bring
^3355FF5 Cyfars^000000 and
^3355FF1 Phracon^000000 to me,
so that I can craft
my own Kunai to use
against Wildcat Joe!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
赶快把
^3355FF5个赛依伐^000000和
^3355FF1个强化武器金属-级数一^000000带给我，
好让我制作自己的苦无
来对付野猫乔！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Whoa, whoa...
You still have some
leftover Skill Points.
You'd better spend all
of them before you
change jobs, right?
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
哇，哇……
你还剩一些
技能点数没用。
在转职之前最好
把它们全部用完，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Ah, you're back with
everything that I need.
You've come earlier than
I expected, eh? Great,
as promised, I'll turn
you into a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
啊，你把我需要的
东西都带回来了。
你来得比我预期的还早啊？
很好，按照约定，
我会让你成为忍者。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Let me formally introduce
myself. I am High Ninja Kuuga Gai
in the Touga Ninja Corps, and
I'm in charge of the search
party to find Sir Kazma.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
让我正式介绍一下自己。
我是东贺忍者队的高阶忍者空牙·盖，
负责寻找卡兹玛大人的搜索队。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Sir Kazma is the chief
of my village, but he's
run away. This has resulted
in an internal conflict within
the Ninja Corps. Things are
pretty unstable right now...
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
卡兹玛大人是我们村庄的首领，
但他逃走了。
这导致忍者队内部发生了冲突。
现在的局势非常不稳定……

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
I initially didn't want to
accept you as a Ninja because
of this complicated situation.
However, you've proven that
you're truly worthy of joining
the Ninja ranks.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
因为这种复杂的局面，
我起初并不想接纳你成为忍者。
然而，你已经证明了自己
确实有资格加入忍者的行列。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
According to his letter, even
Joe thinks highly of you. Just
remember that, as a Ninja, your
mission is your highest priority. But don't let mission objectives
supersede your conscience.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
根据他的信，连乔都很看重你。
只要记住，作为忍者，
任务是你的最高优先级。
但不要让任务目标凌驾于你的良知之上。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
''Secrecy above all else.''
To keep our secrets in the
shadows, you can only buy
or sell Ninja weapons with
authorized dealers. Please
keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
“保密高于一切。”
为了将我们的秘密隐藏在阴影中，
你只能向授权的荷官购买或出售
忍者武器。请务必牢记这一点。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
As of today, you are
now a proud member of the
Touga Ninja Corps. Be as
agile as the wind, and as
quiet as the falling shadows.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
从今天起，你就是
东贺忍者队光荣的一员了。
要像风一样敏捷，
像落下的影子一样安静。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
How have you been?
Train hard: you want
to be able to vanish
without a trace. If you
can do that, you'll get
the respect of any Ninja~
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
最近过得怎么样？
努力训练吧：
你要做到能够
无影无踪地消失。
如果能做到这一点，
你会得到任何忍者的尊重~

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
How have you been?
Train hard: you want
to be able to vanish
without a trace. If you
can do that, you'll get
the respect of any Ninja~
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
最近过得怎么样？
努力训练吧：
你要做到能够
无影无踪地消失。
如果能做到这一点，
你会得到任何忍者的尊重~

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
What...?
How were you able
to find me hidden
in the shadows?!
You must be more than
a common adventurer, eh?
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
什么……？
你是怎么找到
藏在阴影中的我的？！
你一定不只是个普通的冒险者，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
I've traveled to many
countries, but I've never
been on a building as high
as Einbroch Tower. All the
buildings in my hometown
are tiny in comparison...
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
我去过很多国家，
但从未登上过像
艾音布罗克中央塔这么高的建筑。
和我家乡的建筑相比，
那些都显得微不足道……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, are you from
Amatsu? I'm looking
for someone named
Wildcat Joe from there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，你是来自樱花城的吗？
我在找那里一个叫
野猫乔的人。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
...No. No, I'm actually
from Izlude, and I'm only
here in Einbroch for some
minerals. Tell me, why are
you looking for this Wildcat Joe?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
……不。不，我其实来自依斯鲁得岛，
来艾音布罗克只是为了找些矿石。
告诉我，你为什么在找这个野猫乔？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I need to deliver
this letter to him and
get his response so that
I can become a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我需要把这封信交给他，
并得到他的回复，
这样我才能成为忍者。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Really? Now that I think
about it, I do think that I've
run once or twice into him
in this town. Though, he prefers to be called ''Red Leopard Joe,''
instead of ''Wildcat Joe.''
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
真的吗？现在想想，
我确实觉得在这个城镇里
遇到过他一两次。
不过，他更喜欢被称为“红豹 乔”，
而不是“野猫乔”。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I really want to help you
find him, but first I need
to find the minerals that
I'm looking for. If you don't
mind, would you help me?
Then I can help you find Joe.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我很想帮你找到他，
但首先我得找到
我要找的矿石。
如果你不介意的话，
能帮帮我吗？
然后我就可以帮你找乔了。

scripts.text: Don't worry, I'll find him alone.
scripts.translation: 别担心，我会自己找到他。

scripts.text: Sure, I'll help you.
scripts.translation: 当然，我会帮你。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
You sure about that...?
Red Leopard Joe is a true
master of disguise. You'll
need all the help you can
get to find him...
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
你确定吗……？
红豹 乔是伪装的大师。
要想找到他，
你需要所有的帮助……

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Great, I'm glad to
hear that. Please
help me find
^3355FF5 Cyfars^000000 and
^3355FF1 Phracon^000000.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
太好了，很高兴听到你这么说。
请帮我找到
^3355FF5个赛依伐^000000和
^3355FF1个强化武器金属-级数一^000000。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Please bring
^3355FF5 Cyfars^000000 and
^3355FF1 Phracon^000000 to me as
soon as you can. Then,
I can help you find
Red Leopard Joe.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
请尽快把
^3355FF5个赛依伐^000000和
^3355FF1个强化武器金属-级数一^000000带给我。
然后，我就能帮你找到红豹 乔了。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Good, good. You've
brought the minerals...
Now, it's my turn to
help you now. Here,
let me see that letter.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
好，好。你把矿石带来了……
现在，轮到我帮你了。
来，让我看看那封信。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Why? Didn't you bring Kuuga Gai's letter for me?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
为什么？你不是带了空牙·盖给我的信吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you...
Are you Wildcat Joe?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是……
你是野猫乔吗？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
...Yes, but I prefer to
be called Red Leopard Joe.
Kuuga Gai sent you to me, right?
He's the only one who calls
me that. So you want to be
a Ninja, eh? Hmm, alright.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
……是的，但我更喜欢被称为红豹 乔。
是空牙·盖派你来的，对吧？
只有他那样叫我。
所以你想成为忍者，嗯？好吧。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
If you want to be a Ninja,
you should always be careful
of what you see and what you trust. Don't forget that if your
secrets are ever discovered, then you're finished as a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
如果你想成为忍者，
就要时刻小心你所看到的
和你所信任的事物。
别忘了，如果你的秘密被发现，
你的忍者生涯就结束了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Remember to move
quickly, and to always
vanish without a trace.
To remain hidden in the
shadows is really our
ultimate power.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
记住要行动迅速，
并且总是无影无踪地消失。
隐藏在阴影中才是我们真正的力量。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
For now, let me read
this letter. Let's see...
Hm. I thought that Kuuga Gai
would want to challenge me
again, but he actually wants
a temporary truce? Hah!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
现在，让我读读这封信。
让我看看……
嗯。我以为空牙·盖会想再次挑战我，
但他竟然想要暂时休战？哈！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Thanks to your help,
I now have the minerals
I need to construct a Kunai!
Hahaha! I won't agree to a truce when I have the advantage!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
多亏了你的帮助，
我现在有了制作苦无所需的矿石！
哈哈哈！当我占据优势时，
我可不会同意休战！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Anyway, let me write my
response to him. I'll also
give you my recommendation...
I think you'll make a very fine
Ninja, even if I did trick you
just earlier. Heh heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
总之，让我给他写个回复。
我也会给你写封推荐信……
我觉得你会成为一名优秀的忍者，
即使我刚才耍了你。嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Here you go.
Please bring this
letter to Kuuga Gai.
It'll take a while to
return to Amatsu, so let
me send you there directly...
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
给你。
请把这封信带给空牙·盖。
回樱花城需要一段时间，
所以我直接送你过去吧……

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Eh? I'm not sure what
happened, but it seems
that you haven't delivered
my response to Kuuga Gai yet.
Shall I directly send you
to Amatsu right now?
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
咦？我不知道发生了什么，
但看来你还没有把我的回复
交给空牙·盖。
我现在直接送你去樱花城好吗？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不，谢谢。

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，请。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Alright. Well, I was
just trying to save
you some time.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
好吧。嗯，我只是想帮你节省点时间。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Okay, then.
Goodbye for now.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
好吧。
再见。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Kuuga Gai asked you to
gather some materials
too? Oh well, I suppose
that I can't blame him.
Besides, I should be able
to beat him in a fair fight~
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
空牙·盖也让你收集材料了？
哦，我想我也不能怪他。
况且，我应该能在公平的战斗中打败他~

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Oh, you're a Ninja~
I hope you continue to
train yourself and master
all the Ninja skills that
you can. Always remember
to blend into the shadows.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
哦，你是忍者~
希望你继续训练，
掌握所有你能学会的忍者技能。
永远记得融入阴影之中。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I've traveled to many
countries, but I've never
been on a building as high
as Einbroch Tower. All the
buildings in my hometown
are tiny in comparison...
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我去过很多国家，
但从未登上过像
艾音布罗克中央塔这么高的建筑。
和我家乡的建筑相比，
那些都显得微不足道……
